<security_assessment>

<details>
The PKGBUILD file contains a standard AUR package build script for the aimp-skin-aurora package. The source URL points to the official GitHub repository (aimp.ru), which is the legitimate upstream source for this AIMP skin. A valid SHA256 checksum is provided for the archive file. The installation process uses conventional commands: extracting the archive with bsdtar, moving files into the destination directory, removing empty directories, and setting appropriate permission bits (755 for directories, 644 for files). All operations are standard packaging practices and show no signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized modifications. The script follows typical AUR packaging patterns without any suspicious behavior such as eval, base64 decoding, or unexpected system calls.
</details>

<security_assessment>

<details>
The .SRCINFO file contains standard metadata for the aimp-skin-aurora package. It specifies the package description, version, dependencies, source URL, and checksum. The source is downloaded from the official aimp.ru site (a trusted source for AIMP skins) with a specific item ID. The SHA256 checksum is provided and not set to SKIP, allowing verification. The use of & in the URL is an XML escape for the ampersand character, which is standard in .SRCINFO files generated by the AUR web interface and does not affect the actual download URL used by makepkg (which would use the unescaped form in the PKGBUILD). There are no signs of obfuscation, unauthorized network requests, dangerous commands, or anomalous file operations. The metadata aligns with typical packaging practices for a skin package targeting the AIMP media player.
</details>
